people.name: Capernaum
people.line: Town in Galilee; center of Jesus' ministry

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
translations.bsb: got into a boat, and started across the sea to Capernaum. It was already dark, and Jesus had not yet gone out to them.
translations.kjv: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
translations.asv: and they entered into a boat, and were going over the sea unto Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus had not yet come to them.
